senses.en_definition: Fixed, settled, or definite; not subject to change.
Clear, evident, or established beyond doubt.

messages.en: Are you coming hiking with us tomorrow? I'm trying to get a headcount.
I'm not sure I can make it yet. I need to check my work schedule first, in case I've got a morning shift.
Okay, check first. Let me know once you know, yeah?

senses.en_definition: Of course; certainly; surely. Used to emphasize certainty or an expected result.

messages.en: Are you still coming tomorrow? I'm trying to work out how many people to feed.
Of course I'm coming! I promised you, didn't I?
Haha, just checking. Be here at seven, okay? Don't be late.
I've read that theory, but I still don't get it.
Want me to explain it? Let's just start with an example.

senses.en_definition: Directly aligned with a direction or exactly at a specified position.
Accurately hitting the intended target; on target.
Exact, with no deviation in time, amount, or measure; precisely.
Accurate or correct; matching the facts or expressing something precisely.
Appropriate or suitable; well judged or pertinent.
Measuring exactly ninety degrees, as an angle.

messages.en: Can we meet at the station entrance tomorrow at eight in the morning, sharp?
Sure. I'll get there a bit early to grab some bread first.
